name: comp-319
blurb: Example terms dialog requiring scroll to bottom before acceptance.
description: A premade dialog template for terms acceptance that tracks scroll position and enables the action button only when the user has read to the bottom.
use_when: Building terms/legal dialogs where reading compliance is required.
avoid_when: For optional reading — use a standard dialog instead.
a11y: Uses Dialog primitives with scroll event tracking for compliance verification.
